note: Resort beside the Big Piney River near Licking, with canoe, kayak and tube rentals and float shuttles, a pool, a bar and grill and two cabins. The RV loop sits back from the river; the tent area is on the bank. --Claude
summary: Park With Us read: 34 FHU 30/50A sites (40-85 ft), $40-50 a night (most $42-45); 29-30 sites open on weeknights in Nov and Jun. Waterfront DOWN riverview -> not waterfront: the RV oval sits 80-250 m from the Big Piney behind a lane and a wooded bank, no confirmable sightline.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWN: riverview -> not waterfront. The operator's site map puts all 34 RV sites in one oval loop; on imagery that oval is SE of the river, its nearest (west-end) pads ~80-100 m from the Big Piney's bank and most 150-250 m, with Route BB's lane and a wooded strip along the bank in between (bare trees in the leaf-off image; canopy in season). The river is ~35-45 m wide here (riverview would be the right tier if a sightline existed), but none can be confirmed from the pads, so it goes down. Only the tent area is 'on the banks of the Big Piney River' per the operator. apply.py does not write waterfront - set by hand.

Price gate: $40-50 pre-tax per night on Park With Us (cheapest 30A FHU site 5/6 at $40; RV Life 6/2025 camper report $37). No gateway within 40 km - not needed. Presence: own site with phone (573) 889-9085 + Park With Us booking; Google 4.4 over 50 reviews; RV Life 4* over 1.

Long-stay: the operator mentions 'long-term campers' among its guests but markets no weekly/monthly rate; 29 sites bookable 2026-11-17 (Tue) and 30 on 2027-06-08 (Tue), so the long-stay tests pass on their face.
Season: stored year_round (note-derived) left - the operator states no season; the booking engine sells November and December nights. New owners restoring the park after floods (RV Life 6/2025).
